name: Crashed probe
text: An old survey probe, crashed into a hillside and half buried. Whoever sent it never came back for it.

outcomes.result: Most of the probe comes out whole, and part of it is worth fitting.
The hillside comes down on the dig. Someone is hurt, but its panels are in the hold.

choices.label: Strip its panels
choices.result: The probe's panels and frame, light and easy to carry.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.result: It can lie there a while longer.
